structure: Main prediction: the sprinklers will turn on at 10:00 (sign + clock at 9:59) and soak the volunteers.
Knock-on effect: the laptop and sign-up sheets on the blanket next to a sprinkler.
Second scene: the mulch truck backing up toward the parked bike.
Third scene + ending: the dog digging up a sapling; how the organizers will react.
modelAnswer: It looks like this tree-planting event is about to get a lot wetter than anyone expected. There's a sign saying the irrigation system starts at ten, and the clock on the post shows one minute to ten. Several sprinkler heads are sticking out of the grass right where the volunteers are kneeling and planting trees, so they're going to get soaked in a matter of seconds. Even worse, a laptop and some sign-up sheets have been left on a blanket right beside one of the sprinklers, so the organizers could lose their list of volunteers. Meanwhile, in the background, an orange truck full of mulch is backing up, and there's a bicycle parked right behind it. Since nobody is guiding the driver, I'm afraid the truck will run it over. And in the bottom left corner, a dog that's slipped off its leash is digging up one of the young trees that was just planted, so someone will have to replant it. Hopefully, the woman with the clipboard will notice the time and warn everyone.

usefulExpressions.expression: …is about to get a lot wetter than anyone expected
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Sắp ướt hơn mọi người tưởng — mở bài dí dỏm, tự nhiên
Chỉ trong vài giây — nhấn mạnh việc sắp xảy ra
Tệ hơn nữa — thêm dự đoán nghiêm trọng hơn
Tôi e là… — dự đoán điều xấu một cách lịch sự
Hy vọng là… — kết thúc bằng một kết cục tích cực có thể xảy ra

commonMistakes: Không nhận ra manh mối thời gian (biển 'Irrigation starts 10:00' và đồng hồ 9:59), nên bỏ lỡ dự đoán chính.
Nói 'the truck is backing' thiếu 'up'; cụm đúng là 'back up' (lùi xe).
Dùng thì hiện tại cho dự đoán: 'the sprinklers turn on and wet them' → 'the sprinklers will turn on and soak them'.
